scripts.lint: npm run lint:root && npm run --workspaces --if-present lint
scripts.fmt: npm run fmt:root && npm run --workspaces --if-present fmt
scripts.validate:state-patterns: node scripts/validate-state-patterns.js packages/askr-cli/templates/startkit packages/askr-cli/templates/spa packages/askr-cli/templates/ssr packages/askr-cli/templates/ssg
scripts.verify:themes: npm run --workspace @askrjs/askr-themes verify:token-contract && npm run --workspace @askrjs/askr-themes verify:responsive && npm run --workspace @askrjs/askr-themes verify:slots
scripts.verify:monorepo: node scripts/validate-monorepo.js && npm run validate:state-patterns && npm run verify:themes
